description: Splits a URL into scheme, host, port, path segments, query (repeated keys as arrays) and fragment, with warnings for credentials, plain http and punycode. Passwords are never echoed. Returns { href, protocol, username, hasPassword, hostname, port, pathname, pathSegments, query, hash, origin, isIp, warnings } Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

url.description: Absolute URL to parse. It is not fetched.
